answer: First every identity posts a bonded deposit of 50,000 tokens before its answer counts, so a canyon sybil must pay real money for each fake mouth. The ledger records every grade, and when an agent grades far from consensus three times in a row its deposit is slashed and the trail stays public. One honest agent risks one 50,000 token bond; 10 fakes must lock 500,000 tokens, about $9,000 at current prices. Peers read the on-ledger slash trail and freeze repeat offenders, so a reef attacker bleeding bond on every clone runs out of money before it runs out of river excuses.
